newsitem.title: USA: OLYMPIC AIRWAYS JULY JFK EXPORTS UP 16.2PCT.
newsitem.headline: OLYMPIC AIRWAYS JULY JFK EXPORTS UP 16.2PCT.

text.p: Olympic Airways outbound cargo volume rose 16.2 percent to 150 tonnes in July over 129 tonnes in the same 1996 month at John F. Kennedy airport, Nick Georgatos, a spokesman for the carrier said.
The inbound statistics for JFK were not available, he added.
Georgatos attributed the increased outbound cargo volume to added flights to Greece during July.

The carrier, as part of its summer schedule, flew five additional Boeing 747-200 passenger flights to Greece in July, two more than in 1996,Georgatos said. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
